titre: Devoir de contrôle n°2 - Anglais (9ème année de base)

exercices.enonce:
TEXT
Pollution is one of the biggest problems in the world today. In many cities, the air is dirty because of cars, factories and the burning of rubbish. This polluted air is dangerous for our health: it causes breathing problems and other diseases. Water is also polluted when people throw waste into rivers and seas, which kills fish and plants. However, we can all do something to protect our environment. We should use bicycles instead of cars, recycle paper and plastic, and plant more trees. If everyone makes a small effort, our planet will become a cleaner and healthier place.

I. READING COMPREHENSION (8 marks)
1) According to the text, what makes the air dirty in cities?   (2 marks)
2) Why is polluted air dangerous?   (2 marks)
3) Give two solutions mentioned in the text to protect the environment.   (2 marks)
4) "which kills fish and plants." What does "which" refer to?   (2 marks)

II. LANGUAGE (6 marks)
1) Complete with the correct modal (should / must) to give advice: We ______ use bicycles instead of cars.   (1,5 marks)
2) Put into the passive voice: "People throw waste into rivers."   (2 marks)
3) Complete the first conditional: If everyone makes an effort, our planet ______ (become) cleaner.   (1,5 marks)
4) Give the opposite of "clean" = ______.   (1 mark)

III. WRITING (6 marks)
"How can we protect our environment?" Write a short paragraph (about 8 lines) giving at least two solutions and explaining why they are important. Use should / must and linkers.
